title: JSDF Type 20 - Rifle and Grenade Section
description: Protected rifle section with native two-shot fire, selectable dispersed formation and fragmentation grenade ability. 450 range; 210 ammunition.
long_description: Native two-shot rifle cycle with accuracy 80, velocity field 850, armour 8 and selectable loose spacing 3 x 4.5. Guard capable; skirmish retreat disabled. Blinding Grenades activates the existing fragmentation projectile at range 5-75, for 60s with 180s recharge; throw animation and explosion damage require in-game verification. Native Rapid Volley gives a temporary reload boost. Five-round bursts, full-auto and individual magazine reloads are not implemented. Existing Tosa/Spencer visuals remain placeholders.
